answer.explanation: In the window, CrudApiFunction repeatedly failed with AccessDeniedException on dynamodb:PutItem against CartTable, saying no identity-based policy allows the action. The live inline policy app-policy on lambda-rca-bench-CrudApiRole-yMmCSPkJv9jm grants only dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:Query, so PutItem is missing. The IaC template grants PutItem, GetItem and Query, so the deployed role has drifted from the intended state. The function's live configuration (memory, timeout, environment, concurrency) matches the IaC, and the CrudApi function was last modified at 18:40:31, before the window, so this is an IAM permission gap rather than a CONFIG or IAC change.
